scene: The lantern hallway opens onto a misty transit dock bustling with transports.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a stone dock beside misty water. Far left, a large orange koi-shaped boat bobs tied to iron posts. Left, the grandfather pushes his bicycle with plants. Centre, a green garden tram sits waiting on tracks. Far right, a sleek bento express car rests behind open sliding station gates.
shown: a giant orange koi-shaped boat floating tied to the jetty at far left
a glass-topped green garden tram idling with doors open on tracks at centre
a sleek bento express monorail waiting at its platform gate on the far right
